asserted_claims: Unit clocks give a uniform full Fourier distribution.
Nonunit clocks reveal only the known gcd(t,N).
Exhaustive moment inversion works in five cases but is exponential in bit length.
difference: r647 STRUCTURAL_MISMATCH E8_COUNT_FACTOR_EQUIVALENT_NO_FAST_READOUT is preserved. The new proposal tests a specific possible Fourier bypass and refutes additional factor information in its measurement distribution, not all E8 quantum algorithms.
method: All-N character-orthogonality proof plus independent exact small-N Gauss sums, full numerical Fourier distributions and factor-blind exhaustive moment inversion.
next_test: A different proposal must supply another coherent observable or operation whose complete input-to-output cost is polynomial in log N without factors or exact count supplied.
object: For even integral unimodular G of rank 8 and N>=2, prepare psi_t(x)=N^-4 exp(2 pi i t x^T G x/(2N)), Fourier transform over (Z/N)^8 and measure b. Prove Pr(b)=(d/N)^8 if each b_i is divisible by d=gcd(t,N), zero otherwise.
obligations: State preparation and readout costs count
No hidden factor or count oracle
All-N proof limited to named protocol
scope: This precise prepare-Fourier-measure protocol only; no general quantum lower bound. Five semiprime moment examples compute from N alone using N gcd evaluations.
stop_condition: Stop if the output depends only on a classically available gcd or if state preparation/readout needs the sought factors or exponential resources.
target: efficient factor readout from E8 quadratic phase
